# Credit Risk Assessment and Review Standards

This document details the necessary updates and reviews for managing credit risk.

## Key Actions:

*   Update the collateral value standard.
*   Review the interest rates standard.
*   Review borrower credit scores quarterly.
*   Update collateral values based on audit findings.
*   Review borrower credit scores urgently as needed.
